name: continuum
description: Privacy-first, event-driven context infrastructure for Codex.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @continuum/contracts && npm run build -w @continuum/core && npm run build -w @continuum/vscode-collector && npm --prefix collectors/chrome run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @continuum/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @continuum/core && npm run build -w @continuum/vscode-collector
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:collectors && npm run test:native
scripts.test:collectors: npm run test -w @continuum/vscode-collector && npm --prefix collectors/chrome test && npm --prefix integrations/zsh test && npm --prefix integrations/git test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:mcp
scripts.smoke:ollama: npm run build -w @continuum/core && node packages/continuum/dist/cli/main.js smoke-provider ollama gemma3n:e2b
scripts.smoke:openai: npm run build -w @continuum/core && node packages/continuum/dist/cli/main.js smoke-provider openai gpt-5.6-terra
scripts.benchmark:retrieval: npm run build -w @continuum/core && node packages/continuum/dist/cli/main.js benchmark-retrieval 10000
